title: HelperFSWriteCommitResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's write-commit op: the one outcome this session had, and it never changes. `committed` means the bytes are in place at path and version describes the file now there; asking again with the same id answers this answer again without touching the file, so the target's inode does not move. `aborted` means this daemon knows the session wrote nothing. `unknown-outcome` means the daemon never held this session — it restarted, or another generation answered the open — and current is the target as it stands, which the caller compares against the digest it intended.

outcome.description: Which of the three mutually exclusive outcomes this session had.

path.description: The path the answer is about: the target the bytes were installed at when committed, and the caller's requested path otherwise.

version.description: Present exactly when the outcome is `committed`: the version of the file now at path — its size, its mtime and the digest of exactly the bytes this session wrote.

current.description: Present for `unknown-outcome` when the target exists: the target's metadata as it is now. Omitted when there is no target at all, which is itself an answer — nothing was installed.

mtimeNs.description: The target's modification time in Unix nanoseconds.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the target's bytes. Present ONLY when the target's size equals the size the caller stated, because a digest of a file of another size answers a question the caller did not ask.
